conflicts: The long, tousled light-brown hair directly conflicts with Corporal Mahmoud's required short black military haircut and the production rule that Egyptian commandos have short black hair.
The conspicuously curled mustache with upturned ends is overly stylized for a 1973 commando in field service and should be conventionally trimmed.
The anchor has very thick dark eyebrows rather than the written sparse light-brown eyebrows.

issues: Photorealistic with credible anatomy, skin texture and freckles, but the highly groomed hair, curled mustache, striking eyes and polished portrait treatment read more like a fashion casting image than an ordinary serviceman.
Hair length and color are incompatible with the role and production rules.
The elaborate mustache is not credible field grooming for this commando role.
The eyebrows do not match the written look.
No visible text, watermark or anatomical artifact.
The night-moonlight face appears older and narrower than the anchor, with altered cheek, eye and mustache proportions.
The soaking-wet face has a longer, harder facial structure and different nose, jaw and eye proportions from the anchor.
Every image reinforces the prohibited long tousled hair and curled mustache; there are no references with the required short black military haircut.
There are no references showing the character's taped wire-rim glasses, leaving the model unprepared to preserve identity under this recurring facial occlusion.
There are no military-uniform or field-radio character references, despite the actor playing only this commando role.
The set otherwise has useful variation in angles, expressions, lighting, outfits, framing and action, with no obvious duplicates, hand defects, text or modern props.
Captions appropriately identify changing pose, lighting, setting and clothing without describing facial identity.

redesign_change: Replace the long light-brown hair with a short regulation black military haircut, trim the curled upturned mustache into a short natural service mustache, and make the eyebrows sparse light brown while retaining the same age, oval freckled face, green-grey eyes, nose, chin and slight build.
summary: The current signature grooming cannot represent a bare-headed 1973 Egyptian commando and is consistently baked into the training set; redesign the anchor first, then rebuild the set around the regulation haircut with limited glasses and character-costume coverage.
name: Sherif Mansour
